promptEs: Escuchá el dictado en 6/8. ¿Qué secuencia representa el tresillo de negras y la negra final?
explanationEs: El compás de 6/8 equivale a tres tiempos de negra: el tresillo de negras ocupa dos y la negra final completa la tercera.
choices: Negra de tresillo, Negra de tresillo, Negra de tresillo, Negra
promptEn: Listen to the dictation in 6/8. Which sequence represents the quarter-note triplet and the final quarter note?
explanationEn: The 6/8 measure equals three quarter-note beats: the quarter-note triplet takes two and the final quarter note completes the third.
choicesEn: Triplet quarter note, Triplet quarter note, Triplet quarter note, Quarter note
Quarter note, Quarter note, Quarter note, Quarter note
Triplet quarter note, Eighth note, Quarter note
Half note, Quarter note, Quarter note
